scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @studynarrator/web && npm run build --workspace @studynarrator/server && npm run build --workspace @studynarrator/desktop
scripts.dev:web: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev --workspace @studynarrator/server" "npm run dev --workspace @studynarrator/web"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build --workspace @studynarrator/desktop && npm run rebuild:native --workspace @studynarrator/desktop && concurrently --kill-others --names web,desktop "npm run dev --workspace @studynarrator/web" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run start --workspace @studynarrator/desktop"
